### Initial Editing Plan

**Beat 1: Cold Open & Drinks Aisle Knockoffs (0:00–0:22)**
* Open immediately on Giorgos shouting and spinning the camera to create a dizzying, fast whip transition into the store. [[clip: IMG_5414 | 0.94s-5.24s]]
* Add bold phonetic caps on-screen ("VIRGOLINIIIII ZVIOUUUU") without translation.
* Establish a fast-paced, comedic jazz music bed underneath the montage. [[sound: 6eed9ec2-7e81-45b4-82d6-9b9c7309e7ef]]
* Cut into the drinks aisle as Giorgos spots the €6 Greenall's gin sharing colors with Beefeater. [[clip: IMG_5415 | 55.47s-66.83s]]
* Follow immediately with Giorgos calling out the fake Malibu bottle that turns out to be Cayo Lago. [[clip: IMG_5415 | 110.29s-122.17s]]
* Graphic overlays: Display side-by-side brand callouts ("Greenall's ≈ Beefeater", "Cayo Lago ≈ Malibu").

**Beat 2: Comic Breather & The €2 "Wine" (0:22–0:38)**
* Insert a quick 2-second comic breather cut of the sneeze rotated 180° (*Note: Missing coverage clip_6 requiring source footage*).
* Cut back to the drinks section as Giorgos celebrates finding €2 wine, only to realize in disbelief that it is an artificial cocktail mix. [[clip: IMG_5416 | 11.6s-24.94s]]
* Graphic overlay: Display "Cocktail ≈ Wine".

**Beat 3: Motor Oil Axe & Linen Outro (0:38–0:55)**
* Cut to the personal care aisle where Giorgos inspects "Desert Hit," comparing its scent to Axe Africa and marveling at the motor-oil container design. [[clip: IMG_5417 | 6.6s-29.86s]]
* Graphic overlay: Display "Desert Hit ≈ Axe Africa".
* Conclude the edit away from the grocery aisles with Giorgos enthusiastically inspecting and trying on linen trousers. [[clip: IMG_5417 | 60.8s-67.26s]]
* Cut audio and music sharply on the final comedic reaction to wrap under the 60-second limit.
